description: Where a U.S. federal agency or contracting office sits: department -> sub-tier agency -> office. Give a name, an abbreviation (DOD, DLA) or a toptier/subtier code (097, USN). Returns the best match, its parent chain, its sub-units ranked by awarded contract value (with a total count), and other close matches. Awards value is lifetime awarded value in our index.

agency.description: Agency or office name, abbreviation, or toptier/subtier code.

name: get_agency_hierarchy
title: U.S. federal agency hierarchy
